summary: Saratoga Investment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Eighteenth Supplemental Indenture for the issuance of $85.0 million aggregate principal amount of 8.00% Notes due 2031. The notes pay interest quarterly, mature August 31, 2031, and are redeemable at par on or after August 26, 2028. Proceeds will redeem outstanding 6.00% notes due 2027. The notes are unsecured, pari passu with existing unsecured debt. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
